_comment: Drop this entry into your MCP client config and edit the paths/credentials.
The connector is read-only unless FRESHDESK_ENABLE_WRITES is set to 'true'.
Do not commit real API keys - prefer your OS keychain or an env-var indirection.

freshdesk-local-mock._comment: Same server, pointed at the bundled mock. Useful for demos and for testing an agent's prompt without touching a real account. Start it with: python -m freshdesk_connector.cli mock --port 8099
